response.overview: In the heart of the majestic Swiss Alps, content creator and adventurer Abdullah Classic embarks on an epic journey that tests physical and mental endurance. The film documents the challenging ascent of the legendary Serser Luca mountain and camping on its edge amidst harsh yet breathtaking nature. From daily camp preparations and physical hurdles to descending treacherous rocky trails, the film offers a raw, personal, and immersive documentary experience.
response.tagline: The ultimate alpine challenge on the edge of the world.
response.title: Sarsar Luka

results.name: تحدي صعود جبل سرسر لوكا والنوم على حافته... أغبى قرار سويته بحياتي!
